# Albert Jonathan — Full-Stack Engineer & Assistant Lead

> Personal portfolio, technical background, living in Malaysia field guides, curated tools (100% free and open-source for personal and small business use), and full-stack projects by Albert Jonathan.

## Overview

Albert Jonathan is a Full-Stack Engineer & Assistant Lead based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia with 6+ years of production experience across React, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel, Next.js, Svelte, and Java Spring Boot. He specializes in enterprise frontend architecture, legacy modernization, and banking microservices at Accenture Malaysia for a major Singapore banking client. Outside software engineering, he is an active player focusing on Lacrosse Sixes for the Malaysia Lacrosse Federation and an internationally certified D1 Referee under the Asia Pacific Lacrosse Union (APLU).

## Featured Projects

- [Weather Analytics & Alert Platform](https://github.com/jo-bert/weather-analytics): Full-stack meteorological intelligence platform engineered with Laravel 11, Inertia.js 2.0, Vue 3 (Composition API, TypeScript), PostgreSQL, and Docker (Laravel Sail). Features interactive Leaflet weather maps, Chart.js meteorological trend visualizations, background queue jobs for weather data ingestion (OpenWeatherMap, WeatherAPI), API rate limiting, caching, and a configurable alert rule engine.
- [Curated Web Tools Platform](https://albertjonathan.dev/#tools): Client-side, privacy-first open-source web utility catalog built with Preact and Tailwind CSS for offline-capable document conversions, desktop apps, and developer formatting without third-party telemetry.

## Academic & Career Background

- **Accenture Technology Centre Malaysia**: Application Development Senior Analyst — Assistant Lead & Individual Contributor delivering banking form engines, legacy modernization (React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Webpack), defect remediation (SonarQube, Veracode), SIT environment stability (Apache, JBoss), and release governance for a Tier-1 Singapore banking client.
- **Photobook Worldwide**: Web Developer scaling high-traffic consumer React e-commerce applications using SCSS, Docker, and REST/GraphQL integrations.
- **Independent & Contract**: Senior Frontend Consultant directing Vue to Svelte migrations (100 Lighthouse) and logistics tracking systems.
- **Education & Credentials**: BSc (Hons) Computer Science (Data Analytics) from Staffordshire University, UK / APU Malaysia; Google Cloud Digital Leader certified.

## Annual Engineering Ritual (Hackathons)

- **The Great Malaysia AI Hackathon 2025 (Team LARP)**: Built a Google Chrome extension allowing job seekers to tailor their resumes in real-time based on opened LinkedIn job posts. Integrated AWS cloud infrastructure to parse/compile LaTeX & text inputs, orchestrating prompts through in-house LLMs.
- **Superteam Malaysia Solana Hackathon 2024 (Yankee Swap)**: Architected a cross-chain DeFi yield protocol powered by Wormhole. Solved liquidity fragmentation by routing Solana user capital into major EVM protocols (Aave, Pendle, Uniswap) without leaving Solana.

## Recommended Tools & Resources

- [Bitwarden](https://bitwarden.com): Industry-standard, end-to-end encrypted open-source password manager for personal and small business security.
- [ZapFast](https://zapfast.rocks/): Fast, lightweight, and open-source WhatsApp desktop client for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- [Sumatra PDF](https://www.sumatrapdfreader.org): Lightning-fast, ultra-lightweight open-source reader for PDF, eBook, and comic book formats.
- [VERT.sh](https://vert.sh/convert): Private in-browser open-source file converter without cloud server uploads.
- [Stirling-PDF](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF): Powerful open-source web application for PDF splitting, merging, conversion, and OCR.
- [CyberChef](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef): The Cyber Swiss Army Knife by GCHQ for encoding, decoding, encryption, and data parsing.
- [Cobalt](https://cobalt.tools): Ad-free, open-source media downloader for YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, and TikTok.
- [Docmost](https://docmost.com/docs/): Self-hosted open-source collaborative wiki and knowledge base platform.
- [9router](https://github.com/decolua/9router): AI router and fallback gateway connecting coding agents to 40+ LLM providers.
- [Goose AI Agent](https://goose-docs.ai): Open-source native developer agent by Block for terminal automation and desktop workflows.
- [Exercism](https://exercism.org/dashboard): 100% free code practice and mentorship across 70+ programming languages.
- [anti-slop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop): Oxlint AST rules to reject AI code slop and maintain strict codebase hygiene.
